title: Commander George Hoover on aliens saying 'you don't know how powerful you are'

tellings.quote: or Commander George Hoover of the Navy actually talked about this. Aliens often come down, they say, you don't know how powerful you are.

plain: A Navy commander named George Hoover is said to have spoken about aliens who come down and tell people, "you don't know how powerful you are." Michels mentions this in passing, without saying where or when Hoover said it, during his interview with David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who testified to Congress about UFOs. If true, it would mean the visitors' message is about hidden human abilities.
